Two Fibocom modules sent data through Starlink Direct to Cell using the hardware and software they already had. With a clear view of the sky, they connected in about 1 to 30 seconds. Downloads reached 2.2 Mbps, and uploads were around 0.3 Mbps.

That could let farm sensors send readings and equipment trackers report their location from places cell towers can’t reach.

NEWS: SpaceX is challenging South Africa’s telecom licence rules, saying costly licence transfers make it harder for new internet providers to compete. 

Local operator Easttel says buying a network licence and a service licence from existing holders can cost over R1 million, plus R84,738 per licence just to apply for the transfer.

SpaceX called for direct applications in January. ICASA’s initial review backs up its concerns, and the regulator is giving the public 45 working days to comment on new network licences.

That could remove one hurdle for Starlink. With the required approvals, it could bring high-speed internet to rural homes and schools with few options.

New GTA 6 details:

- Download size is 209.9GB
- The game has a shared base, with story and online (later) being separate
- Japanese version is missing a 1.37GB file
- New Zealand and Australia versions are missing a 0.688MB file
- Rest of the world have the same version
- Supports 120hz/HFR (potential 40fps mode on PS5 Pro) and a new version of PSSR2 (all features will be announced by Sony soon)
- Metadata suggests the size could reach up to 343.6GB in future

(via @Tex2Funz2: https://gtaforums.com/topic/1007789-gta-vi-launch-waiting-room-up-to-212-gb-depending-on-device-edition/?do=findComment&comment=1072854671)

New GTA 6 Festival details:

- Takes place in in Wynwood Miami, on November 21st
-Presented by Rockstar in partnership with PlayStation and produced by the creators of III Points
- Features artists from the game (Kodak Black) and the official soundtrack (Travis Scott CardiB, Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Justice, Metro Boomin, Rauw & Friends)
- Will feature 2 stages of live performances

(Source: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/gtavi-thefestival)
